about: Gripper centres (midpoint of the two Dex1 fingertips) in the first head frames (head_stereo_left, 640x480) of the episodes fetched by tools/recording_layouts.py frames. Read by eye from 4x zoomed crops with a 10 px grid (Claude, 2026-11-20); about +-5 px. Used by `recording_layouts.py fitcam` to correct chiral's G1 head camera for this dataset.
